💰 FinOps Pricing Model, Free Tier & CUDs

Billing Model: Hourly Gateway / Policy / Rule Base + Processed Data or Queries
Metered Units: Resource-hour • GiB processed • per-1M requests/queries
Free Tier: Standard Metering Core IAM & VPC firewall rules included; advanced tiers metered
Committed Use Discounts: Enterprise subscription tiers available (e.g., Cloud Armor Enterprise, SCC Enterprise)
Key Cost Watchouts:
  • Cross-region / internet data processing & egress volume (GiB)
  • Number of active forwarding rules, tunnels, or WAF policies
  • Packet mirroring & VPC Flow Logs sampling ingestion volume
